title: Diag log readers: grep/since/until before the cap + truncated marker (journalctl 2000, log_file 1000)
note: Held PR for manager; Tier-2 (ict-web-api diag router, needs web-api restart). Caps measured from code: journalctl _MAX_JOURNAL_LINES=2000 (-n), log_file _MAX_LIMIT=1000 applied after readlines(); neither marked truncation. Fix: grep= (substring, pre-cap) on both, window streaming on journalctl, truncated + lines_scanned/matched/returned/dropped + read_state on both. VERIFY AFTER DEPLOY (merged != deployed != observed): relay journalctl?unit=ict-trader-live&since=<6h ago>&grep=order_monitor&lines=50 -> lines_scanned > 2000 and a truncated field; log_file?name=audit&lines=5 -> truncated + lines_scanned. Then BACKLOG-DRAIN re-runs its landed_unproven history greps.
